extracted.intended_audience: general readers and industry watchers interested in entertainment news and corporate PR/crisis stories
extracted.subtask_description: Analysis or reporting of a corporate apology/press statement issued in response to public backlash over advertising; focuses on the content of the apology and corrective actions taken. Useful for evaluating crisis communication and press-release elements after reputational incidents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apology content / acknowledgement of error
rubrics_metrics.description: The statement explicitly acknowledges missing the mark and issues an apology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example language from the page: "Clearly we missed the mark, and we apologize. We did not intend to make light of any serious issue." A strong corporate apology should acknowledge the mistake, name the harm (or at least admit a failure), and offer an unambiguous apology rather than defensive language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarification of intent
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain what the company was trying to communicate or achieve, while distinguishing that intent from the impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pepsi's statement: "Pepsi was trying to project a global message of unity, peace and understanding." Guidance: State the intended message to provide context, but avoid letting stated intent excuse harmful impact; intent should be paired with acknowledgement of consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrective action (remove content and halt rollout)
rubrics_metrics.description: Take concrete steps to remove the offensive material and stop further distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pepsi: "We are removing the content and halting any further rollout." Effective crisis responses include immediate, visible corrective actions (content removal, pausing campaigns) so the public sees tangible remediation rather than only words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apologize for harm to individuals placed in a compromising position
rubrics_metrics.description: If a person (e.g., a public figure or employee) was put in an awkward or harmful position by the content, explicitly apologize for that.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pepsi: "We also apologize for putting Kendall Jenner in this position." Guidance: Acknowledge and apologize for the effect on participants or third parties featured in the content as part of taking responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid trivializing serious social and political issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Messaging should not capitalize on or make light of recent social and political issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article notes the ad "drew the ire of Twitter users... lambasted the commercial for capitalizing on and trivializing recent social and political issues." Anti-pattern: using protest imagery or social movements as a superficial backdrop for product marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor social platforms and remove from official channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Track audience reaction on social media and ensure offending content is removed from official accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The piece notes the Jenner ad "no longer appears to be available on the official Pepsi Twitter and Facebook pages." Guidance: Rapid monitoring and takedown from brand channels is part of an effective immediate response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipate and prepare for broader media amplification and satire
rubrics_metrics.description: Expect that backlash will be amplified by late-night, mainstream media, and influencers; plan messaging accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article references "Late-Night TV Savages Kendall Jenner Pepsi Ad" and extensive social mockery. Guidance: Crisis teams should anticipate secondary coverage and satire that increase reputational harm and should prepare concise, consistent responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be sensitive to historical and community perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize how imagery or messaging may resonate with historical figures, movements, or affected communities and be prepared for community leaders to respond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example from the page: Martin Luther King Jr.'s daughter Bernice King singled out the ad. Guidance: Consult or consider perspectives of community leaders and historical context before deploying content that references social movements.
